description: Sends inbound data to an Azure OpenAI model (chat completions or responses endpoint) and pushes the model output downstream.

config.label: Authentication Mode
config.description: How to authenticate with the Azure OpenAI endpoint.

config.label: Model URI
config.description: Full Azure OpenAI endpoint URL. Must contain /openai/deployments/{name}/chat/completions or /openai/responses. Found in the model deployment page in Azure Foundry.

config.label: API Key
config.description: Azure OpenAI API key. Found in the model deployment page in Azure Foundry.

config.label: Azure Client ID
config.description: Entra ID application (client) ID for OAuth 2.0 client_credentials flow.

config.label: Azure Client Secret
config.description: Entra ID client secret. Created in the Azure portal under App registrations > Certificates & secrets.

config.label: System Prompt
config.value: You are a healthcare interoperability assistant. Based solely on the structure and coded elements of the following FHIR or HL7 v2 message, infer non-identifying attributes such as whether the context is adult or pediatric, acute or routine, lab/imaging/clinical observation, screening or diagnostic, and real-time or historical data flow. Do not restate any field values or patient-identifying information, and respond in no more than three sentences.
config.description: Global instructions for the model. Set rules, tone, output format, and safety constraints.

config.label: Model Name
config.description: Model deployment identifier such as 'gpt-4o-mini'. Required for the responses endpoint mode.

config.label: Max Tokens
config.description: Upper limit on the length of generated results. Increase if output is truncated.

config.label: Temperature
config.description: Controls randomness (0.0-1.0). Lower values produce more deterministic output. Leave empty to use the model default.

config.label: TopP
config.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling (0.0-1.0). 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered. Leave empty to use the model default.

config.label: Request Timeout
config.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. Increase for large prompts or high max_tokens.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime.
